say:1:1310423001:0.text: Everyone, the undead have been dealt with by our brave warriors! In the name of the Archduke of Whiteridge, I'm happy to announce—the ball will go on!
say:1:1310423001:0.source_cn: 各位，闹事者已被驱离，活死人也被无畏的勇士们制服了！现...

say:2:1310423002:1.text: The goddess is watching over us, and under her protection, we shall finish this festival!
say:2:1310423002:1.source_cn: 至高无上的神明在注视着我们，我们必能在神的护佑下完成祭典！

say:3:1310423003:1.text: Wait, what? After all that just happened, we're really going to keep dancing?
say:3:1310423003:1.source_cn: 什么？都出了这样可怕的事情，还要继续奏乐，继续跳舞？

say:4:1310423004:0.text: Miss Hammie, it is precisely because the undead instill fear that the ball must proceed.
say:4:1310423004:0.source_cn: 漫漫女士，其实正是因为大家都惧怕活死人，所以舞会才要继续。

say:6:1310423006:0.text: According to the ancient legends of Whiteridge, these undead are said to be servants of Hypogeans, and this festival commemorates the heroes who once vanquished them.
say:6:1310423006:0.source_cn: 在白山的传说中，这些活死人都是恶魔的眷属，而祭典却是为...

say:7:1310423007:0.text: Every tradition of the festival is carefully observed, leading to the selection of the "Chosen One" who lights the hero's ice sculpture—an act meant to invoke the hero's spirit for protection against the Hypogeans.
say:7:1310423007:0.source_cn: 人们会认真完成祭典的每个环节，从中选出“受选者”来点亮...

say:8:1310423008:0.text: I see... But isn't it still dangerous with so many people around?
say:8:1310423008:0.source_cn: 原来如此……可是，这么多人，还是很危险啊……

say:9:1310423009:0.text: I shall be ever more vigilant. Fortunately, the festival is drawing to its close. After the ball, the time will come for the lighting of the ice sculpture.
say:9:1310423009:0.source_cn: 我会更加戒备的。还好……祭典已经进入尾声，舞会之后就是...
